# Vendored Apache ECharts

- Package: `echarts@6.0.0` (Apache-2.0).
- Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/echarts/6.0.0
- File: unmodified `package/dist/echarts.min.js` from the official npm tarball.
- npm distribution SHA-512 integrity verified when downloaded on 2026-09-28.
- LICENSE and NOTICE are copied verbatim from the same package.
- Loaded from the local writing service, with no CDN, online fonts or runtime fetch.
- HaloCue.spec includes the entire writing/web directory in desktop builds.

The graph code is HaloCue's independent implementation of standard ECharts graph
APIs. The installed lieflat-charts B2 template informed the interaction direction,
but its PolyForm Noncommercial source and sample data are NOT bundled or copied.
